Real startup, component rendering, SQLite migrations and service registrations are exercised.

Persistence, validation, repository and migration fixtures use SqliteTestDatabase (a real isolated SQLite database and IDbContextFactory<ApplicationDbContext>). See diagram 7 for all nested helpers and interface realization relationships.
Pink = test fixture; amber = test helper; other colors = production types; grey = external framework. «tests» is a dependency, never inheritance.
